notes_text: 300B active is a judgment on the 2026-09 pricing cross-check, not an OpenAI disclosure: the price column's own central is 250B and equalizing Astra's markup against OpenAI's own ladder gives 333B. Sensitivity 100-600B, moving dependent FLOPs 0.33x to 2.0x. Recurrent-depth decoding would multiply the coefficient by undisclosed passes.

Never publicly released, so no availability date is established. Described only as significantly more capable than GPT-6 Astra, in training since 2026-08-28; agents moved to a further-trained version mid-run, so this record covers two checkpoints as one identity. Active count is tied to gpt-6-astra at 300B; sensitivity 100-800B.

Identity unresolved: an internal Anthropic research model, never released or named, described only as roughly comparable to Claude Fable 5.1, the comparability anchor rather than the model. Both release fields are blank: it was never public. 150B active transfers the Fable-class anchor; 55-400B moves dependent FLOPs 0.37x to 2.7x.

40B active is a serving-throughput and capability-tier estimate, not a disclosure; it places Haiku 4.5 with its Flash-class peers rather than with Haiku 3. Sensitivity 15-80B, moving dependent FLOPs 0.38x to 2.0x.

150B active is an inference-economics estimate off the September 2026 price and decode-speed ladder; no architecture size is disclosed. Sensitivity 60-400B, moving dependent FLOPs 0.4x to 2.7x. Source benchmark does not give an exact effort or API revision.

300B active is a training-compute route at era-appropriate token-to-parameter ratios, checked against 2024 peer disclosures; it replaces a backward transfer from Opus 4 serving-bandwidth estimates. Sensitivity 120-600B, moving dependent FLOPs 0.4x to 2.0x.
30B active is read off the price step over Haiku 3 at launch, not a disclosure; the earlier value was a flat transfer from the Haiku 3 prior. Sensitivity 12-60B, moving dependent FLOPs 0.4x to 2.0x.

200B active transfers the 2025 frontier peer scale; the earlier 115B was the released Grok 2 architecture carried forward, which understates a generation step. Sensitivity 80-450B, moving dependent FLOPs 0.4x to 2.25x. API changelog says April 3; Epoch lists April 9.
